svg.title: What AgentBuff does
svg.desc: Ready-made AI employees: Hire a packaged employee such as a cashier assistant, a bookkeeper or a customer service agent, and it is working in your chat in minutes. Custom agents: Build your own agent with a persona, skills, channels and routines. One account can run several agents, each with its own context. Work where you chat: Agents answer in WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat and email. Replies are paced to feel human, not instant bursts. Voice calls: Call your agent live from the web app. It can also answer with voice notes in the chat channels. Marketplace: Skills, connectors and business apps in one catalog: Kasir POS, Buff Your Money, KostCloud, Absentra and Smart Home. Policy layers: Platform rules are layered into every agent's instructions, so each employee stays inside what the business allows. Billing: Checkout with QRIS, e-wallets and virtual accounts through Midtrans, with trials, coupons, refunds and PDF receipts. Sign in with AgentBuff: An identity provider for partner apps. One login, one entitlement check, and the agent connects to the app over MCP.
svg.text: The parts of AgentBuff people use every day.
